column1: # The FFI modules of the pointer lint (//:pointer_lint, tools/build/lint/defs.bzl,
# pointer_lint; the rules: docs/design/mojo_safety_and_idioms.md): the files whose
# MutUntrackedOrigin) are FFI internals, so not sites. One row per file,
# tab-separated: <file> <the foreign resource it owns>. A row's file must hold a
# comment line starting `# FFI-BOUNDARY:` and must name a wildcard origin, or the
# row fails the build. The other pointer rules hold here as anywhere.
